g.text: 1. LVGO / HVGO pumps serve pumparound + product; pumparound return temperatures control column heat removal.
2. VR, HVGO product and slop wax lines steam traced (ST) - high pour point.
3. Slop wax cooling not in Rev A equipment list - routed hot to OSBL slop (see data issue log).
4. E-201 LP steam generator: VR on tube side; continuous blowdown to OSBL blowdown drum.
5. Line numbers: <NPS>-<fluid>-<area>-<seq>-<class>-<insulation> per CONVENTIONS; see line list CFU-000-PI-LL-001.
6. All vents / drains 3/4" min. with blind or cap; HPV/LPD to piping specification. Valve sizes = line size UNO.
7. Instrument tags per ISA-5.1; index CFU-000-IC-IDX-001. SIS functions per SRS (SIF tags shown in interlocks).
397 m2 bare; 1 bay(s) 6 m x 12 m, 2 fans
MAT'L CS tubes, Al fins (A-101: CS + inlet ferrules, Ti optional)
361 m2 bare; 1 bay(s) 6 m x 12 m, 2 fans
MAT'L CS tubes, Al fins (A-101: CS + inlet ferrules, Ti optional)
SHELL: BFW / LP steam / TUBE: Vacuum residue
